newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in extremely thin after-hours trade on Monday, as the market suffered from a lack of fresh incentives, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen per kg lower to 0.3 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark June was flat at 145.6 yen.

During the day, prices drifted sideways in directionless trade. "Private investors' interest was more in other commodity futures such as grain. In addition, a seasonal rise in rubber output in producing countries thinned fresh buying interest here," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk
